title: Chapter 1370
text:
"The Underworld?"

Upon hearing this name, the revivors were in an uproar. Because they were in a different era, their reactions were completely different.

Some people knew what the Underworld was and sized up Hella in shock. Some people were confused and did not know what it meant. After asking for a while, they finally understood the meaning of the Underworld. Their expressions could not help but change slightly, and they felt a strong sense of fear.

Nilfgadi, who had been watching the show, frowned. He looked at Hella and said in a deep voice,

"Speaking of which, the ability of that recovery-type Esper was very familiar. What's your relationship with Nerkese and Eros?"

He was also a Primordial One and was from the same era as the two sisters of the Underworld. From the beginning, he felt that Hella and Aurora's abilities were familiar.

Hella looked down at him and said calmly, "The two of them died a long time ago. We inherited [Dawn of Life], [Power of the Dead], and the Underworld they left behind."

"I see …" Nilfgadi nodded slowly and did not say anything else.

Seeing that he had no other questions, Hella ignored him and looked at everyone coldly.

"Black Star has already given you enough face. Don't push your luck. I'll say it again. If you don't want to live, you can continue to cause trouble. Let's see if we can send all of you to the Underworld!"

Han Xiao spoke at the right time and pretended to reprimand her. "Hella! Everyone here is a senior. Watch your words. "

"Hmph." Hella threw away Aegon Vardnadze's remains, turned around, and returned to the crowd, not saying another word.

Hearing the two of them, some of the revivors looked embarrassed, but they did not dare to do anything extreme.

The deterrence of the Underworld was not small. Compared to entering the Underworld, house arrest seemed to be acceptable …

Furthermore, Black Star's ability to play Aegon Vardnadze in the palm of his hand and kill him made many of the revivors wary.

However, although Aegon Vardnadze was killed, most of the revivors did not feel sad. They had watched the entire process and naturally knew that it was not Black Star's one-sided attack. Aegon Vardnadze had only himself to blame, so they could not blame him.

As for the Beyond Grade As on Han Xiao's side, not only did they not feel disgusted, they even felt happy. Who asked Aegon Vardnadze to be so bold as to cut the healer? Even if Black Star did not do anything, many people wanted to kill this guy.

Killing people to establish his might made it easy for people to think that he was threatening the revivors. In order to prevent such repercussions, Han Xiao did not want to kill anyone, but Aegon Vardnadze had courted death himself. That was a special case. It was simply wonderful that he could make both sides feel that he deserved to die.

Just as he was worrying about how to establish his might, Aegon Vardnadze had presented him with an excellent opportunity, and it wouldn't cause any backlash. He was a good person who had helped him in his hour of need. He would feel bad if he didn't instruct the eight brothers of the Underworld to take care of him!

Seeing that the revivors had stopped their commotion, Han Xiao knew that this wave of punishment had worked and dispelled everyone's thoughts of causing trouble.

However, this was not enough. His main goal was not to put them under house arrest but to persuade these people to participate in the war voluntarily.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and said, "Actually, in this war, you don't have to pay for it.

"In fact, inviting you all to participate in the war is not asking you to contribute for free. This is also a transaction. I believe that you will be satisfied with this price."

Hearing this, the revivors looked interested.

"Oh? What's the reward? "

Hilbert asked curiously.

Han Xiao smiled and gave them a strong dose of medicine according to the plan.

"As long as you choose to participate in the war, no matter how many times you die in battle, I will wake you up again. If one day we expel the foreign enemies, the participants will always enjoy the right to the Sanctum Revival and obtain a permanent safety guarantee. However, if you don't participate in the war today, you won't have the chance to exchange for it in the future. This is my price."

The revivors present were stunned for a moment before their hearts palpitated.

If that was the case, then there would be no worries. Using participation in the war in exchange for the right to the Sanctum Revival forever was definitely an extremely worthwhile deal!

Furthermore, there was still the current ability user of [Dawn of Life], so there was a certain guarantee of survival on the battlefield. It would not be so easy to die in battle. It was worth a try!

The only question was whether Black Star would keep his word.

Observing everyone's reaction, Han Xiao smiled and said, "Everyone, there's no need to doubt my sincerity. The Sanctum Revival is not difficult for me. Reviving you guys is just a piece of cake."

Reeve could not help but question, "You mean the Sanctum Revival can be used endlessly? Are there no restrictions? "

"Hehe, there really isn't. Everyone, don't worry. No matter how many times you die, the Sanctum Revival can still take effect."

Han Xiao replied with a smile. When he introduced the situation earlier, he did not repeat the lie that the Sanctum Revival could only be used once, so this group of revivors did not know about it.

As soon as he said that, the surrounding association members could not help but look at him. Although there was no expression on their faces, they sighed in their hearts …

Black Star's ability to lie through his teeth was getting better and better!

Many association members believed that there was only one chance for the Sanctum Revival. They had been lying for too long and had already taken it to be true. They did not believe Han Xiao's words. In their opinion, this was just a lie that Black Star had deliberately made up to trick this group of revivors to participate in the battle.

However, no one had any intention of revealing the 'truth' because it was in their interest to trick more revivors to participate in the battle. Furthermore, this lie was ineffective against 'insiders' like them.

This separated the difference between the current Beyond Grade As and the historical revivors. Many association members believed that they would not fall for it, and even if they revived, they would not fall for it. Therefore, there was a difference in treatment that would not harm their group's interests. Therefore, no one intended to expose Han Xiao's' lie '. Even Garoze and the others who had just revived chose to remain silent. Instead, they felt that Black Star had made a good move.

Seeing how tempted the revivors were, the association members chuckled in their hearts. They could not help but feel a sense of superiority as if they had grasped the truth.

At the same time, Kasuyi glanced at his companions around him. He knew that no one took him seriously, and the corners of his mouth could not help but twitch.

As someone who knew the truth, of course, he knew that Han Xiao was telling the truth. However, these current Beyond Grade As had already been fooled by Black Star, and no one believed him!

Kasuyi did not know whether to laugh or cry.

'Forget it, it's not a big problem. When Black Star proves it with his actions, they'll know which is the truth …'

He was not worried that Black Star's plan would fail. The three Universal Civilizations and the association members would probably hide the 'truth' out of their own interests. Many revivors had to be controlled and could not freely access information from the outside world, so the three Universal Civilizations would naturally screen out the information that might reveal the 'truth'.

Even if the revivors knew the 'truth', there were still some direct revivors who were willing to sacrifice themselves. As long as a battle broke out, a wave of people died, and the second revival was successfully carried out, everyone would understand that what he said today was true. The situation would immediately return to the right track, and they would continue to rush forward.

'With so many backup plans, everything is under control. Black Star is still stable …'

Kasuyi praised in his heart.

On the other side, many revivors were shaken by Han Xiao's conditions and were conflicted.

Hilbert's eyes flashed, and he said seriously,

"If what you said is true, this deal is worth doing. I can serve the civilization again and fight against the enemies."

"It's fine. You have plenty of time to think about it."

Han Xiao smiled nonchalantly.

As he spoke, he waved his hand and unfolded a spaceship. It landed on the bumpy ground, and the hatch opened, inviting everyone to board.

The revivors had already accepted Han Xiao's words and did not express any objections. They obediently boarded the spaceship.

Everyone boarded the starship and quickly set off for the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening teleportation point set up by the three Universal Civilizations, preparing to jump to the interception circle.

The cabin was harmonious, and there were no confrontational relationships. Many of the current Beyond Grade As had finally established a relationship with the various revivors, and many of them had reunited after a long time.

Looking at this harmonious scene, Han Xiaoxin heaved a sigh of relief.

The preliminary negotiations have been completed for the time being. I've finally mobilized the enthusiasm of this group of revivors to participate in the battle … I wonder how many Beyond Grade As outside of the revivors believe my words.

Han Xiao could not help but smirk.

The war had already broken out, and the unlimited Sanctum Revival would be revealed sooner or later. He had no intention of hiding it all the time. Using this reason to convince these revivors was a plan that he had made long ago, and he was not afraid of the three Universal Civilizations finding out.

However, the previous lie was too deeply rooted in their hearts. Han Xiao believed that the three Universal Civilizations and the association members would most likely be skeptical of his change of words. As long as there was no actual proof, these people would be more willing to believe the lie of 'the Sanctum Revival is only limited to one time'.

However, although Han Xiao planned to reveal the fact that there was no limit to the Sanctum Revival, he did not want to tell the truth completely. He had already prepared an explanation for the three Universal Civilizations after the truth was exposed, and he had hidden a trick inside.

Beep beep beep …

While he was thinking, his communicator suddenly rang. Han Xiao took it out and saw that it was a call invitation from the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations.

Without hesitation, he entered the quantum network and projected a remote projection.

He turned around and found himself in the office of the three Universal Civilizations' leaders, facing the three of them.

"Thank you for your hard work, Black Star. These revivors have been stabilized by you." Marbruce nodded. "Thank you for thinking about the big picture and bringing back so many high-level combatants. This will make up for many of our disadvantages."

"Don't just thank me verbally." Han Xiao chuckled.

"Don't worry, we've already prepared the substantial rewards." Marbruce paused for a moment before suddenly asking, "By the way, we also provided Gaud as a medium, but why didn't he revive?"

"I'm not sure. Either the medium is wrong, or this guy isn't dead and is hiding in some corner."

Han Xiao's expression did not change. This kind of problem could be solved with just a push, and it did not affect him at all.

"So he's not dead … I got it."

Marbruce glanced at Han Xiao and did not intend to pursue the matter further.

At this time, the Ethereal Pope interrupted and asked slowly,

"Black Star, what you said just now is that there's no limit to the number of Sanctum Revivals. Is that true or false?"

"What do you think?" Han Xiao asked.

"… I think this is just an excuse you used to stabilize the revivors." The Ethereal Pope spread out his hands. "But nothing is absolute in this world. Maybe this is the truth."

The other two also stared at Han Xiao curiously.

Hearing this, Han Xiao shrugged and said casually, "It's all up to you whether it's true or not.

"It doesn't matter which version you believe. When the situation develops to that point, you'll naturally know whether it's true or not. Before that, I personally suggest that you treat what I just said as false. Anyone who considers the worst outcome in advance will definitely not make a mistake."

Without waiting for anyone to respond, Han Xiao continued, "Your current task right now is to focus on the current situation.

"Your current urgent job is to put these revivors under house arrest and ensure that they can't come into contact with the truth. Otherwise, if they retreat again, then I won't be able to do anything."

"… You're right."

The three of them looked at each other, suppressed the doubts in their hearts, and nodded at the same time.

They were still more inclined to believe that the so-called 'unlimited Sanctum Revivals' was a lie Han Xiao used to fool the revivors.

With Black Star's personality, how could he reveal such a trump card so easily? It was most likely a lie!

In any case, it was common for Black Star to lie through his teeth, and they were already used to it. They did not panic at all and even wanted to laugh.
